A reader that does not recalculate can therefore display0. Agree on supplied caches or a deliberate recalculation step; no Office engine ran and this observation does not require a library patch.

Enabling conversion produces numeric123 and loses the leading zeros. write_string keeps =1+2 as literal text without a formula node. Use explicit text/type policy for identifiers and expression-looking labels instead of treating every numeric-looking value as a measurement.

Emit forward row-major data or choose normal memory mode,and inspect each write return code. Successful close is not proof that every requested cell was accepted.
